Generate standup report: Done, open Blockers and Next items, and a Stale line

## Usage

    gournal standup [options]

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `-y, --yesterday` | Include yesterday's entries |  |
| `-w, --week` | Show weekly summary |  |
| `-m, --month` | Show monthly summary |  |
| `--from <date>` | Start date (inclusive, local day or ISO timestamp) |  |
| `--to <date>` | End date (inclusive, local day or ISO timestamp) |  |
| `-p, --project <project>` | Filter by project name |  |
| `--repo <owner/name>` | Filter by repository |  |
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Comma-separated tags |  |
| `--activity` | List all GitHub activity that has no entry, not only the counts |  |
